summary: Selects one named Extra Output POP made available by a GLSL Advanced POP. It is the downstream branch point for extra outputs declared on the GLSL Advanced POP Extra Outputs page.

key_params.name: pop
key_params.note: Reference to the GLSL Advanced POP whose Extra Output POP should be selected.

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Output Name matching one extra output configured on the selected GLSL Advanced POP.

key_params.name: bypass
key_params.note: Passes the first input through unchanged when bypassed.

key_params.name: freeextragpumem
key_params.note: Frees accumulated GPU memory after output memory has grown and shrunk.

key_params.name: delinputattrs
key_params.note: Outputs only attributes specified by this POP, useful for isolating selected-output attributes into a branch.

common_gotchas: Output Name must exactly match an Extra Output name configured on the referenced GLSL Advanced POP.
GLSL Select POP does not create extra outputs; it selects one named extra output that the GLSL Advanced POP already exposes.
Keep extra-output names stable in builder templates because downstream GLSL Select POP nodes reference those names as strings.
The selected output's point, primitive, and vertex attribute availability comes from the matching extra-output attribute scopes on GLSL Advanced POP.
Delete Input Attributes can prune attributes from the selected output branch, so verify render, convert, or downstream GLSL stages still receive the attributes they expect.
Use Free Extra GPU Memory after changing extra-output capacities or topology-heavy branches during iterative development.
Use an Info CHOP to inspect cook, warning, and error channels when an expected extra output name does not appear downstream.
